title: Patience may start as a listening discipline.
summary: Guru ties patience and honor to hearing Naam. The point is not passive delay, but a heart that has stopped interrupting the medicine.
takeaway: Wait by listening, not by simmering.
lifeApplication: Before reacting to delay, make space to hear one line all the way through.

source.shortMeaning: Patience and honor grow where the ear starts taking in Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Listening can become the first form of obedience.

evidence.coreClaim: Patience and honor grow where the ear starts taking in Naam.
evidence.turn: Patience becomes luminous when it begins listening for Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before reacting to delay, make space to hear one line all the way through.
